answer: My Request Management Service automated end-to-end triage, enrichment, investigation, and resolution across Atlas and ServiceNow. I used Python, FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph to build four agentic workflows with grounded retrieval across Atlas Knowledge Base, Confluence, and Azure AI Search. The solution included a reusable Agent Skills Framework and Sandbox, Microsoft Teams human approvals, dry-run execution, DeepEval evaluation, OpenTelemetry monitoring, and Docker and Helm deployment on AKS. The resume records a scope of more than 200 daily requests, over 70 supported teams, and more than 200 skills across 100 use cases.

question: Explain your AI-Powered CI/CD Root Cause Analysis project
variations: Tell me about the pipeline failure project
How does your GitLab root cause analyzer work?
Explain the CI/CD investigator
answer: My AI-powered CI/CD Root Cause Analysis project uses a four-agent LangGraph workflow to extract GitLab pipeline errors, classify failures into six categories, trace likely root causes, recommend remediation, and correlate historical incidents. It combines Azure OpenAI GPT-4o with an asynchronous FastAPI backend, GitLab REST API v4, background processing, SQLAlchemy, and SQLite. A React 19 and TypeScript dashboard presents execution timelines, RCA summaries, manual log analysis, failure analytics, confidence scores, and incident tracking.

question: Explain your AI Personal Finance Planner
variations: Tell me about the finance project
How does your finance planner work?

answer: My AI Personal Finance Planner uses three specialized agents for financial data collection, investment planning, and goal-based planning. Built with Python, LangChain, LangGraph, GPT-4.1, RAG, React, and TypeScript, it considers income, family context, expenses, goals, and risk preferences. The interface presents structured options across lump-sum investments, stocks, fixed deposits, savings strategies, projected returns, and major goals. It is an educational planning demonstration, not a replacement for licensed financial advice.

question: What is agentic AI?

A useful agent is not simply a chatbot—it has a bounded job, can gather relevant context, call approved tools, and move through a workflow with clear safeguards and stopping conditions.

question: How do you use LangGraph?
variations: What is your LangGraph experience?

answer: I use LangGraph to represent multi-step AI workflows as explicit stateful graphs. It is useful when a process needs branching, retries, tool calls, checkpoints, or human review because the flow becomes easier to reason about than a single opaque chain.

question: How does retrieval-augmented generation work?
variations: Explain RAG
What is your RAG experience?
How do you build a retrieval system?
answer: RAG retrieves relevant source material before generating an answer, giving the model grounded context instead of relying only on its internal knowledge. A dependable RAG system needs thoughtful ingestion, chunking, metadata, retrieval, ranking, citations, and evaluation—not just a vector database connection.

question: What role do vector databases play?
